IC1: Male [OR] or female, 18 years of age or older.
IC2: Study eye with clinically significant diabetic macular edema (DME) [AND] with central subfield thickness [AND] ≥ 350µm on spectral domain OCT
IC3: Best corrected visual acuity (BCVA) of 20/50 to 20/320 ETDRS equivalent (65 letters to 23 letters) in the study eye, with BCVA decrement primarily attributable to DME.
IC4: Treatment naïve, i.e., [NOT] no previous anti-VEGF treatment [OR] in the study eye or [NOT] no anti-VEGF treatment in the 45 days prior to study enrollment.
IC5: In the investigator's opinion, the subject still has significant intraretinal fluid with room for improvement in both macular edema and BCVA.
IC6: Intra-Ocular Pressure (IOP) is under control (i.e., IOP ≤ 25 mm in the study eye) and study eye is [NOT] not receiving any IOP lowering drops.
IC7: Willing and able to return for all study visits.
IC8: Able to meet the extensive post-op evaluation regimen.
IC9: Understands and signs the informed consent form.
